source_title: SNEAKO X Professor Jiang X Aleksandr Dugin | Full Interview
summary: This April 13, 2026 Sneako / Dugin interview is a high-pressure eschatology, dollar, secret-network, and resource-fortress source: it defines eschatology as an end-of-history map, roots modern Western power in the 1694 Bank of England, makes Eurasian financial alternatives a direct threat to American solvency, frames Greater North America as a finance-to-resource empire transition, and replaces single puppet-master accounts with convergence-of-interests and scapegoat/vanguard routing.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang defines eschatology as a tradition's account of where humanity comes from, why it is here, where history is going, and where God and man reunify at the end of history.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Eschatology owns the total-direction script that assigns origin, destination, and role. This source strengthens the definition spine, but the public page is already under compression/watch pressure.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The interview repeatedly treats ordinary geopolitics and end-times geography as two layers that can coincide in the Middle East.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The active mechanism is sacred role geography becoming a geopolitical map. Prediction owns dated scoring; Strategy and Chokepoint own material war mechanics.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says a Russia-China-Iran BRICS/gold-corridor alternative would bankrupt America because U.S. debt depends on continuing Treasury demand.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Dollar Hegemony owns forced demand and reserve-system survival; Power As Alchemy owns the symbolic-financial conversion; Prediction owns future status.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang treats China's gold corridor as a possible Eurasian financial system that would make American debt privilege answerable to an alternative reserve architecture.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Power owns the counter-alchemy where gold and ledger discipline try to constrain privilege. Dollar Hegemony owns the reserve-system demand problem.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says Greater North America would transition America from a financial empire into a resource empire by turning the Western Hemisphere into a fortress.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Imperial Retrenchment already publicly uses this source for resource-fortress pressure; no further public append is needed from intake alone.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang rejects a single-puppet-master account and says Iran-war politics are better read as a convergence of interests.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source is useful precisely because it keeps the secret-network lens from collapsing into one omnipotent hidden actor.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang says visible figures such as Trump, Kushner, Witkoff, and Chabad Lubavitch may be vanguards or scapegoats rather than the deepest actors.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Secret Society owns public faces as visible surfaces for harder-to-name coordination; Proximity Games owns the factional payoff board.

new_lens_seeds.title: Eschatological Geopolitics As Double Map
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A conflict becomes readable at two layers at once: realist power, routes, and alliances on one layer; sacred geography, Antichrist/restrainer roles, prophecy, and end-of-history direction on the other.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The interview gives a compact formulation of a recurring Jiang/Dugin pressure point: prophecy does not replace geopolitics but can align with it until actors read material events as sacred roles.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a seed or future Eschatology replacement/compression phrase. A standalone page would duplicate Eschatology unless clustered links require a narrower hover.

new_lens_seeds.title: The Financial Ponzi Must Fight Eurasia
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A debt-dependent reserve empire treats an alternative Eurasian financial system as existential because losing Treasury demand turns the empire's accounting structure into collapse, civil war, or forced war.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The phrase connects BRICS/gold-corridor alternatives, Iran-war pressure, Treasury dependence, and resource-fortress transition without making any one commodity or route the concept.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as routing vocabulary for Dollar/Power/Chokepoint synthesis. It is too close to existing Dollar Hegemony and resource-empire anchors for public promotion now.

new_lens_seeds.title: The Anti-Human System Remains Attractive
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A system can be spiritually or humanly destructive while still delivering enough prosperity, pleasure, identity, and technological success that people defend it against liberation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: Jiang's objection to Dugin clarifies a recurring diagnostic: moral diagnosis does not predict resistance unless the analyst also explains the system's attractions.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a comparison seed. It needs more dated Jiang sources before becoming a public child rather than a Free Will/Human Heart/Dead World boundary note.
